title: Aegean Sea earthquake of 2020
summary: A strong earthquake, Mw 6.9 to 7.0 depending on the agency, struck Samos Island in the Aegean Sea. It caused 117 deaths in Turkey and Greece, 1632 injuries in Turkey and heavy building damage, especially in İzmir. It also triggered a tsunami that killed one person in Turkey.
